recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the applied FHIR-13060 summary-flag decision in current core source without reopening broader modifier policy.
issue_request: FHIR-13060 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for CDS knowledge resources. It asked for selected summary and modifier flags, but the final resolution and FMG discussion approved the summary additions and rejected applying modifier flags as part of this issue.
initial_application: The historical application is SVN 11646, represented by git commit 3677417ce00bc54c8a58e3d6f12e9ab173932a8f, which added summary flags to old spreadsheet sources for ActivityDefinition, Library, Measure, MeasureReport, PlanDefinition, and RequestGroup. Current StructureDefinition XML preserved most of that work after source migration and RequestGroup-to-RequestOrchestration renaming, but PlanDefinition.action.textEquivalent and MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.measureScore[x] still lacked isSummary.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini shows the relevant current resources are active, and RequestGroup is represented by RequestOrchestration in the current build. Current RequestOrchestration action.description and action.textEquivalent already have summary flags. Later MeasureReport modifier cleanup in FHIR-55366 removed unrelated modifier flags and left status-specific modifier semantics outside this summary-flag reconciliation.
reconciliation: Changed source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml to add isSummary=true to PlanDefinition.action.textEquivalent and source/measurereport/structuredefinition-MeasureReport.xml to add isSummary=true to MeasureReport.group.stratifier.stratum.measureScore[x]. No rejected modifier flags were added or removed.

related_jiras.note: RequestGroup was renamed to RequestOrchestration; the current RequestOrchestration action summary flags preserve the RequestGroup part of FHIR-13060.
Later MeasureReport modifier cleanup removed unrelated modifier flags, supporting the decision to keep this reconciliation limited to summary flags.
